rows.label: Bread
rows.description: baked food made of flour, water and other ingredients
rows.hook: is the baked staple that gets sliced for sandwiches and toast

rows.label: Eiffel Tower
rows.description: tower located on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France
rows.hook: was built as the centerpiece of a world's fair and became its city's best-known symbol

rows.label: Taj Mahal
rows.description: marble mausoleum in Agra, India
rows.hook: was built by a Mughal emperor as a tomb for his beloved wife

rows.label: Statue of Liberty
rows.description: monument in New York
rows.hook: was a gift from France and greets ships arriving in New York Harbor

rows.label: Chocolate
rows.description: nutritionally dense or sweet food product from the seed of Theobroma cacao - cocoa bean
rows.hook: is the sweet treat given in heart-shaped boxes on Valentine's Day

rows.label: Mount Rushmore
rows.description: mountain in South Dakota featuring a sculpture of four US presidents
rows.hook: has the faces of four American presidents carved into its side

rows.label: Water
rows.description: chemical compound whose molecules are formed by two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom
rows.hook: is the clear liquid that covers most of the planet and is essential to all known life

rows.label: Great Pyramid of Giza
rows.description: oldest and largest of the three pyramids in the Giza Necropolis; one of the seven ancient wonders of the world
rows.hook: is the last surviving wonder of the ancient world, built as a pharaoh's tomb

rows.label: Angkor Wat
rows.description: Hindu-Buddhist temple complex in Cambodia
rows.hook: is the world's largest religious monument, famed for its sunrise silhouette

rows.label: Michelangelo's David
rows.description: sculpture by Michelangelo
rows.hook: shows the biblical giant-slayer as a nude youth carved from a single block

rows.label: Petra
rows.description: ancient rock-cut historical city in Jordan
rows.hook: is the "rose-red city" carved into cliffs, seen in an Indiana Jones film

rows.label: Pickle
rows.description: cucumber preserved in vinegar
rows.hook: is a crunchy, tangy snack that goes on burgers and deli sandwiches

rows.label: Lego brick
rows.description: construction toy
rows.hook: is the interlocking toy piece that kids snap together into endless builds

rows.label: Golden Gate Bridge
rows.description: suspension bridge on the San Francisco Bay
rows.hook: is the orange-red landmark often shrouded in fog at the entrance to San Francisco Bay

rows.label: Parthenon
rows.description: former temple of Athena on the Athenian Acropolis, Greece
rows.hook: was a temple to Athena that crowns the Acropolis in Athens

rows.label: Pasta
rows.description: Italian food made from flour, eggs and water and shaped in different forms, usually cooked and served with a sauce
rows.hook: is the Italian staple served as spaghetti, penne and lasagna

rows.label: Leaning Tower of Pisa
rows.description: cathedral bell tower in Pisa, Italy
rows.hook: is the famous tilted landmark said to have hosted Galileo's gravity experiments

rows.label: Sushi
rows.description: portioned prepared vinegared rice topped or rolled with other ingredients
rows.hook: is the Japanese delicacy often topped with raw fish and served with wasabi and soy sauce

rows.label: Brooklyn Bridge
rows.description: bridge in New York City, crossing the East River
rows.hook: is the famous Gothic-arched suspension span linking Manhattan to a neighboring borough

rows.label: Cheese
rows.description: yellow or white, creamy or solid food made from the pressed curds of milk
rows.hook: is the food that comes in cheddar, brie and Swiss varieties

rows.label: Hoover Dam
rows.description: hydroelectric dam on the Colorado River, United States
rows.hook: was a Great Depression public-works marvel that created Lake Mead

rows.label: Diamond
rows.description: allotrope of carbon often used as a gemstone and an abrasive
rows.hook: is the hardest natural substance and the classic stone of engagement rings

rows.label: Sapphire
rows.description: gem variety of corundum
rows.hook: is the deep blue gemstone that is September's birthstone

rows.label: Steel
rows.description: alloy made by combining iron and other elements
rows.hook: is the strong metal used for skyscraper frames, cars and cutlery

rows.label: French fries
rows.description: deep-fried potatoes
rows.hook: is a crispy golden side dish served with burgers and ketchup

rows.label: Kimchi
rows.description: Traditional Korean dish of fermented vegetables
rows.hook: is the spicy fermented side dish served with nearly every Korean meal

rows.label: Tofu
rows.description: soy-based food used as a protein source
rows.hook: is the pressed white block popular as a vegetarian protein

rows.label: Quartz
rows.description: mineral made of silicon and oxygen
rows.hook: is the abundant crystal that keeps time in watches

rows.label: Venus de Milo
rows.description: ancient Greek marble statue of a woman
rows.hook: is the famous armless statue of the goddess of love, displayed in the Louvre

rows.label: Hummus
rows.description: Levantine and Middle Eastern chickpea puree
rows.hook: is the creamy dip made with tahini, lemon and olive oil

rows.label: The Thinker
rows.description: type of sculpture by Auguste Rodin
rows.hook: shows a seated, muscular man resting his chin on his hand in deep contemplation

rows.label: Great Sphinx of Giza
rows.description: ancient Egyptian monumental sculpture
rows.hook: has a lion's body and a human head and guards the pyramids

rows.label: Amber
rows.description: fossilized tree resin
rows.hook: is the golden gem that sometimes traps ancient insects

rows.label: Tower Bridge
rows.description: bascule and suspension bridge in London
rows.hook: is the London landmark whose center lifts to let tall ships pass

rows.label: Bourbon
rows.description: type of American whiskey, a barrel-aged distilled spirit made primarily from corn
rows.hook: is the American whiskey linked to Kentucky and aged in charred oak barrels

rows.label: Honey
rows.description: sweet food made by bees mostly using nectar from flowers
rows.hook: is the golden sweetener that bees make and store in a hive

rows.label: Beer
rows.description: alcoholic beverage obtained by fermenting starchy materials and not distilled
rows.hook: is the foamy drink poured by the pint and served in pubs worldwide

rows.label: Gateway Arch
rows.description: monument in St. Louis, Missouri
rows.hook: is America's tallest human-made monument, a shining curve beside the Mississippi

rows.label: Matryoshka doll
rows.description: Japanese-created Russian cultural icon: set of wooden dolls of decreasing size placed one inside another
rows.hook: is the Russian toy set where smaller figures nest inside larger ones

rows.label: Vinegar
rows.description: liquid consisting mainly of acetic acid and water
rows.hook: is the sour liquid used to dress salads and pickle vegetables

rows.label: Sauerkraut
rows.description: cabbage that has been fermented by various lactic acid bacteria
rows.hook: is the tangy German side dish piled onto hot dogs and Reuben sandwiches

rows.label: Popcorn
rows.description: variety of corn kernel which expands and puffs up on heating
rows.hook: is the classic movie-theater snack that pops when heated

rows.label: Table salt
rows.description: mineral used as food ingredient, composed primarily of sodium chloride
rows.hook: is the white seasoning in every shaker next to the pepper

rows.label: Bagel
rows.description: torus-shaped bread product
rows.hook: is the chewy ring-shaped roll often spread with cream cheese

rows.label: Yogurt
rows.description: food produced by bacterial fermentation of milk
rows.hook: is the tangy, creamy snack sold in cups and often flavored with fruit

rows.label: Wine
rows.description: alcoholic drink typically made from grapes through the fermentation process
rows.hook: is the drink poured from bottles in red and white varieties and sipped from stemmed glasses

rows.label: Glass
rows.description: amorphous solid that exhibits a glass transition when heated towards the liquid state
rows.hook: is the transparent material used for windows and bottles

rows.label: Saxophone
rows.description: single-reed woodwind instrument
rows.hook: is the curvy jazz instrument made famous by Charlie Parker and John Coltrane

rows.label: Manneken Pis
rows.description: bronze sculpture and fountain by Jérôme Duquesnoy the Elder in Brussels, Belgium
rows.hook: is a tiny fountain of a little boy that is a quirky tourist stop in a European capital

rows.label: Emerald
rows.description: green gemstone, a beryl variety
rows.hook: is the green gem that is May's birthstone

rows.label: Ruby
rows.description: variety of corundum, mineral, gemstone
rows.hook: is the red gemstone that is July's birthstone

rows.label: Sake
rows.description: alcoholic beverage of Japanese origin
rows.hook: is the Japanese drink often served in tiny ceramic cups

rows.label: Silk
rows.description: fine, lustrous, natural fiber produced by the larvae of various silk moths, especially the species Bombyx mori
rows.hook: is the luxurious fabric that gave its name to a famous ancient trade route

rows.label: Rum
rows.description: distilled alcoholic beverage made from sugarcane
rows.hook: is the spirit tied to pirates and Caribbean cocktails like the mojito

rows.label: Tequila
rows.description: alcoholic beverage originating from Mexico
rows.hook: is the Mexican spirit behind margaritas and salt-and-lime shots

rows.label: Liberty Bell
rows.description: bell in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA that serves as a symbol of American independence and liberty
rows.hook: is the famous cracked symbol of American freedom

rows.label: Scotch whisky
rows.description: malt or grain whisky (or a blend of the two), made in Scotland in a manner specified by law
rows.hook: is the smoky spirit from the Highlands and Islay, drunk neat or with a splash of water

rows.label: Didgeridoo
rows.description: traditional Australian wind instrument
rows.hook: is the long droning tube played by Aboriginal Australians using circular breathing

rows.label: Linen
rows.description: textile made from spun flax fiber
rows.hook: is the lightweight, wrinkle-prone fabric of summer suits and tablecloths

rows.label: Pearl
rows.description: hard object produced within the soft tissue of a living shelled mollusc
rows.hook: is the lustrous gem found inside oysters and June's birthstone

rows.label: Hash browns
rows.description: dish
rows.hook: is a shredded, golden-fried side served on diner breakfast plates

rows.label: Paper
rows.description: thin, flexible material mainly used for writing upon, printing upon, drawing or for packaging
rows.hook: was first made in ancient China and is used for writing, printing and packaging

rows.label: US dollar bill
rows.description: current denomination of United States currency
rows.hook: is the lowest-value note in circulation and shows the first president on its front

rows.label: Butter
rows.description: dairy product
rows.hook: is a spread churned from milk fat and melted over toast, popcorn and pans

rows.label: Guacamole

rows.hook: is a green, mashed dip served with tortilla chips and first made in Mexico

rows.label: Maple syrup

rows.hook: is the sweet pancake topper collected by tapping trees in late winter and boiling it down

rows.label: Pewter

rows.hook: is a soft, low-melting silvery alloy used for tankards and decorative tableware

rows.label: Champagne
rows.description: sparkling wine from Champagne, France

rows.description: writing implement

rows.label: Lincoln Memorial
rows.description: memorial in Washington, D.C., United States

rows.label: Denim
rows.description: sturdy cotton or cotton-blend twill textile

rows.description: gold mask of the Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun
